parameters.name: AliyunUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account for which the quota increase is requested.

parameters.name: BatchQuotaApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the quota application batch.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of records to return for the current query.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that marks the position from which the query starts.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).

parameters.name: QuotaCategory
parameters.description:
The quota type. Valid values:

- CommonQuota: General quota.

- FlowControl: API rate limit quota.

- WhiteListLabel: Privilege quota.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The approval status of the quota increase request. Valid values:

- Disagree: The request is rejected.

- Agree: The request is approved.

- Process: The request is in review.

- Cancel: The request is closed.
